title: Verify Senior Service Advisor can delete a payment
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Senior Service Advisor role. (this role has Invoicing and Payments: Delete).
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
A payment has been recorded against the invoice.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab and locate the payment.
2. Click Delete on the payment and confirm.
expected: The payment is deleted successfully with no permission error.
